title: Google, Apple hit with W63.7b fine in Korea's app store crackdown
caption:
South Korea's media regulator has issued its first major sanctions against Google and Apple under a 2021 law. The fines target restrictive app store policies regarding payments and review processes.

Source: Koreaherald - Google, Apple hit with W63.7b fine in Korea's app store crackdown
